ui_bugs.issue: openZeffy() uses `noopener,noreferrer` window features. Modern browsers (Chrome/Firefox) return `null` from window.open() when noopener is specified — even on success. The code then treats null as 'popup blocked' and forcibly navigates the CURRENT tab to Zeffy via window.location.href, abandoning the page. User never sees the 'I completed my Zeffy payment' button and the entire confirmation flow is broken in production. Fix: drop the `noopener,noreferrer` arg (or set opened=true regardless), since target=_blank already isolates the opener.

rca of the issue: Two issues found: (1) Backend tx_out helper omitted provider/purpose/approved_* fields → frontend ZeffyDuesApprovals filter `t.provider==='zeffy'` always returned empty. Reproduce: POST /payments/zeffy/confirm as member, then GET /transactions as admin — provider field missing. FIX APPLIED: added 6 missing fields to tx_out. (2) ZeffyCheckout.jsx openZeffy() calls window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer'). Per HTML spec & MDN, browsers return null from window.open when noopener is set even on successful popup. Code then treats null as popup-blocked and runs window.location.href = url, navigating current tab to Zeffy and abandoning the confirmation UI. Reproduce: visit /profile as member with a real browser (no playwright override), click 'Pay dues with Zeffy' → entire tab navigates to zeffy.com, user can no longer return to confirm. MITIGATION: drop 'noopener,noreferrer' from window.open args (target=_blank already implies opener isolation on modern browsers), OR call setOpened(true) before the popup-block check, OR check `w === undefined` instead of `!w`.
